GNPName.description:
One name a place is known by, beside its primary NAME. Every attribute is
carried as the gazetteer publishes it; a consumer choosing a display name
applies its own policy over these flags and never has the choice baked in
by the publisher.

NAME.description: The alternate name verbatim, in its own script, unnormalized.

LANGUAGE.description:
ISO 639 language tag when the gazetteer states one. A gazetteer may also
state a non-language tag for a link or a postal, IATA, ICAO, or similar
coded name; that token is carried verbatim rather than discarded.

IS_PREFERRED.description: The gazetteer marks this as the preferred name for its language.

IS_SHORT.description: The gazetteer marks this as a short form.

IS_COLLOQUIAL.description: The gazetteer marks this as colloquial or unofficial.

IS_HISTORIC.description: The gazetteer marks this name as no longer in use.

VALID_FROM.description:
Period the name was in use, verbatim as the gazetteer states it. Not
normalized to RFC 3339: gazetteers publish partial and era-qualified
dates here, and coercion would invent precision.

GNPProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one gazetteer place.

Required on every record: a redistributed place whose dataset, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is DATA:
DATASET_ID, DATASET_NAME, and ATTRIBUTION carry verbatim what the gazetteer
states about itself. The standard names no gazetteer, dataset, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the gazetteer this place was
taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset registry. Never a
display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this place
was decoded from. The edition boundary, not the fetch: two records
carrying the same DATASET_ID and DATASET_EPOCH were cut from the same
bytes and are directly comparable.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one, so an epoch can be verified rather than trusted.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or file selection used, so the same rows can be
recovered by repeating the fetch.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed place whose terms are unstated. A dataset that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.
Required whenever the terms are attribution-bearing, which is the common
case for open gazetteers, and carried verbatim so a downstream surface
can render it without composing its own credit line.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
This gazetteer's own row identifier for the place, verbatim. The join key
back to the source dataset; never re-minted by the publisher.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC date on which the gazetteer last modified this row, as the
gazetteer states it. Distinct from DATASET_EPOCH: an unchanged row keeps
its modification date across editions, which is what makes incremental
sync possible.

GNP.description:
Gazetteer Named Place

One named geographic place as a gazetteer publishes it: its names, its
position on WGS 84, its feature classification, its administrative
containment, and the dataset edition and licence it was redistributed
under. The record is a NAME-TO-PLACE lookup surface — place search,
geocoding, and administrative resolution — and is deliberately not a
facility, station, or emitter record: $SIT carries an operational
facility, $GST a geodetic tracking station, $TBS a terrestrial base-station
site. A place gains meaning from those records by being joined to, never by
being conflated with them.

Positions are decimal degrees on WGS 84 and elevations are metres,
unconverted. A consumer needing other units converts at the join,
explicitly.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this place record. Never the gazetteer's
own row identifier, which rides verbatim in SOURCE.NATIVE_ID.

NAME.description: Primary name of the place, verbatim in its own script, unnormalized.

ASCII_NAME.description:
Plain-ASCII rendering of NAME when the gazetteer publishes one. A search
and sort convenience, never a substitute for NAME.

ALTERNATE_NAMES.description: Every other name the gazetteer publishes for this place.

LATITUDE.description: Latitude in decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive north.

LONGITUDE.description: Longitude in decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive east.

ELEVATION_M.description:
Elevation in metres above the WGS 84 ellipsoid-referenced vertical datum
the gazetteer states, as published. Zero means unpublished, never sea
level; a place at sea level is distinguished by ELEVATION_PUBLISHED.

ELEVATION_PUBLISHED.description:
ELEVATION_M carries a published value. False marks a gazetteer that
publishes no elevation for this place.

DEM_ELEVATION_M.description:
Elevation in metres sampled from a digital elevation model, when the
gazetteer publishes a model-derived value beside or instead of a surveyed
one. Kept separate: a model sample is not a survey and the two must never
silently substitute for one another.

DEM_MODEL.description:
Name of the digital elevation model DEM_ELEVATION_M was sampled from,
verbatim as the gazetteer states it.

FEATURE_CLASS.description: Broad feature class this gazetteer assigns.

FEATURE_CLASS_CODE.description:
The gazetteer's own class token, verbatim, so a class outside
gnpFeatureClass survives a round trip.

FEATURE_CODE.description: The gazetteer's fine-grained feature code, verbatim.

FEATURE_NAME.description:
Human-readable expansion of FEATURE_CODE, as the gazetteer publishes it.
A display string, never a key.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the gazetteer states it.

COUNTRY_NAME.description:
Country name as the gazetteer publishes it. A display name, never a key:
consumers key on COUNTRY_CODE.

ALTERNATE_COUNTRY_CODES.description:
Further ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for places the gazetteer reports as
spanning or being disputed between several countries. Order carries no
precedence and no sovereignty claim.

ADMIN1_CODE.description: First-order administrative division code within COUNTRY_CODE, verbatim.

ADMIN1_NAME.description:
Resolved name of that division. Carried beside the code so a consumer
need not hold the division tables to render a place.

ADMIN3_CODE.description:
Third- and fourth-order division codes, verbatim. Gazetteers publish
these as codes only; a name is carried when one is published.

POPULATION.description:
Population as the gazetteer publishes it. Zero means unpublished, never
uninhabited.

TIME_ZONE_ID.description: IANA time zone identifier for the place, verbatim.

TIME_ZONE_UTC_OFFSET_H.description:
Offset from UTC in hours the gazetteer states for that zone outside
daylight saving, and under it. Carried as published; a consumer needing
an instant-correct offset resolves TIME_ZONE_ID against a current tz
database rather than trusting these.

TIME_ZONE_DST_OFFSET_H.description: Offset from UTC in hours under daylight saving.

SOURCE.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms. Required: a place with no named
dataset, epoch, and licence is not publishable.
